symptom: Button rendered its loading slot (null) beside the child, so asChild handed Radix Slot two children; the Design layer rows and the provider API key link threw React.Children.only while the renderer suite stayed green because no test rendered Button asChild.
rule: A Slot-backed primitive passes exactly one child under asChild and keeps its own decorations on the plain element; every such primitive has an asChild render test, and a primitive change renders a harness that mounts each call-site shape.
